_about: RATIFIED Company Standard CONF-DEFINITION-NDA-001 (AM-206, 2026-10-26). The position is Legal
Constitution §15's Company Position, quoted verbatim below: confidential information is information
marked confidential, OR information a reasonable person would understand to be confidential. Ratified
with every Constitution position by AM-73; nothing in it is authored. A real NDA protected information
only if it was marked, or confirmed in writing within 30 days — anything said in a meeting fell outside.
PRESENCE: the evaluator reads no clause text; protection for marked information only, with no
reasonable-person limb anywhere in the document, addresses the requirement by departing from it, a
DEVIATION for a person. It is CONFIGURATION: no locked decision is amended.
description: Confidential information covers what is marked confidential and what a reasonable person would understand to be confidential.
source_document: Legal Mind — Legal Constitution, Lawyer Review Version L1.14 (docs/02-legal-domain/LEGAL_CONSTITUTION_L1.14.md)
source_quote: Confidential Information is defined by a two-part test: information marked confidential, or information a reasonable person would understand to be confidential given its nature and the circumstances of disclosure.
